title: webserv (HTTP/1.1 Web Server)
description: An HTTP/1.1 web server written in C++98 from scratch, handling non-blocking sockets, I/O multiplexing (poll/select/epoll/kqueue), CGI execution, and Nginx-style config parsing.
tech: C++98, Sockets, I/O Multiplexing, HTTP/1.1, CGI

title: ft_irc (IRC Server)
description: An Internet Relay Chat (IRC) server compliant with RFC 1459/2812 written in C++98, supporting channels, user authentication, operator modes, and network client management.

title: ft_transcendence (Full-Stack Web Capstone)
description: Final 42 capstone project building a real-time multiplayer Pong platform with OAuth2 authentication, WebSockets, single-page navigation, and microservices.
tech: WebSockets, Single-Page App, OAuth2, Microservices, PostgreSQL

title: Explore Go & Odin Systems Programming
description: Experiment with Odin's explicit context and custom memory allocators, as well as Go's concurrency primitives for building lightweight CLI network tools.

title: Low-Level Kernel & Operating System Concepts
description: Study x86 architecture bootloaders, virtual memory paging, system calls, and interrupt descriptor tables (IDT) for educational OS kernel experiments.
tech: Assembly (x86), C, OS Development, Memory Paging
